item.description:

item.title: Research-Driven Agents: What Happens When Your Agent Reads Before It Codes
item.description:
📝 Key takeaways:Agents that read papers and study competing projects before writing code find optimizations that code-only agents miss. Where code-only context works#Karpathy’s autoresearch showed that a coding agent can autonomously improve a neural network training script. That’s domain knowledge the agent didn’t have.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.skypilot.co/research-driven-agents/
